justification: Two losses in a row means I shake the family up, that's the code, so I went looking for a receiver to bench and found nothing on that bench but tight ends — no receiver in the house means I do it with the backs instead, Breece Hall walks into the flex over Javonte Williams, numbers are basically twins anyway but somebody's gotta feel it this week. Kyler Murray keeps the ball, he's my guy from last week and I don't churn a quarterback for half a point, Bo Nix sits again, not a punishment, just how the math fell. Pittman's got a Questionable next to his name and he's starting anyway — a guy who suits up hurt is worth more to me than a healthy scratch, that's just respect. Achane, Chase Brown, LaPorta, Boutte, the kicker, the defense — they earned their spot Sunday morning, nobody's touching 'em.
